description: Three catalogs none of which can serve an en/ja/th request, so the resolution walk runs the WHOLE candidate chain before falling back to fr. That is the condition under which TranslationResult's constructor validates the accumulated attempted locales (TranslationResult.java:114-126) and meets the compatibility-extension locales the chain synthesises. Norwegian is loaded so the same fixture also carries the bridge control, and nn/nb/fr are three distinct language codes so no tiebreakers are required.
